notes.note: TGL-45: the pre-release switch, on the Updates page and in the security settings.

segment.source: Offers release candidates of the next version. They are tested less than final releases.

notes.note: The configuration file forbids the switch; only root can change the file.

segment.source: No check runs; this decides only whether an uploaded pre-release is offered.
The mirror decides which releases its list holds.
Changing this switch needs a sign-in within the last five minutes. Sign in again and you return to this page.
Pre-releases are off on this installation.
